<!-- stormworks-research-gap:family:air-liquid-heat-exchanger -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts/air-liquid-heat-exchanger).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> The q capacity weighting per fluid type and the through-flow rate were not recovered.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/1/limitations/0`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> All five variants share the same code path and the same 0.03 fraction. If larger variants hold more fluid in their compartments (plausible but not established, because compartment volumes were not recovered), q and the heat moved per update would rise with size.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/1/sections/2/body`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Measure Temp A/Temp B against flow rate to calibrate how fast fluid passing through refreshes each compartment, and compare variants at equal flow to quantify the size effect.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/1/sections/4/body`

**Definition-only extraction**

> Heat-transfer coefficients, effectiveness, flow dependence and time to equilibrium are unknown. The tooltip's size rule is not a measured performance curve.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/6/limitations/4`

**Definition-only extraction**

> Temperature units, flow requirements, fluid compatibility, internal pumping and the direction or rate of heat exchange in a particular installation remain unverified.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/6/limitations/6`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Air-Liquid Heat Exchanger: decode remaining behavior and formulas
